cand.title: Concours Hippique International de Genève – 100 years
cand.organizationName: Concours Hippique International de Genève / Palexpo
cand.excerpt: Five-day centenary international horse show in the airport corridor; pursue teams, sponsors, hospitality and overflow, not assumed inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Most relevant operational lead: Nadja Burkhardt, named recipient of 2026 athlete accommodation requests; accommodation@chi-geneve.ch, +41 79 751 29 81. Best commercial-partnership lead: Hortense Fabre, Head of Sponsorship & Partnerships; hfabre@chi-geneve.ch, +41 78 711 85 25. Pauline Weill is the named 2026 private cocktail-area contact, via +41 22 738 18 00. Sophie Mottu Morel is General Director. Relevance is verified; final hotel-contract signing or procurement authority is not.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming as of 16 November 2026: centenary CHI Geneva, 9–13 December 2026, Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. These are public activity dates, not publication dates. The FEI jumping schedule uses a broader 8–13 December operational window; do not substitute that for the public start date. A later edition is listed by the regional equestrian federation FER for 8–12 December 2027 at Genève, Palexpo (GE). This is federation-calendar evidence, not a located organiser-issued 2027 programme or hotel commitment. No 2028 dates were verified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Commercial inference using the supplied hotel constraints: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a potential airport-corridor satellite base for a limited sponsor, exhibitor, accompanying-party or operational subgroup, not the host of this arena-scale event. A proposal within the supplied 20–120-room commercial band is a prospecting limit, not a demand estimate or a request to take the whole 237-room hotel. Its meeting rooms could support small briefings only if separately requested. Founex is not walkable event-site lodging: any offer needs agreed event-specific transfers and late/early operating times. The hotel advertises an airport shuttle, but that does not establish a Palexpo/event shuttle. This is transport-dependent sports lodging, not demonstrated resort-retreat demand.
findings.venueCommitments: The 2026 event is publicly confirmed at Palexpo, an exhibition/event venue rather than a hotel. Municipality: Le Grand-Saconnex; region: Canton of Geneva; territory: Geneva Airport corridor, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte, downtown Geneva or Lausanne. The official listing establishes the announced venue, not the terms of a private venue contract.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified editions: 6–10 December 2023, 11–15 December 2024 and 10–14 December 2025, all at Palexpo in the Geneva area. Official history records the first Palexpo edition in 1991. This is a repeat fixed-destination event, not evidence of destination bidding/rotation. Recent annual December editions establish recurrence, but do not establish exact 2027/2028 dates. The FER calendar additionally lists 8–12 December 2027 at Palexpo; retain its federation-calendar provenance separately from the 2026 organiser announcement.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific incumbent: Geneva Marriott Hotel, the only hotel named in the reviewed official 2026 accommodation listing and participant hotel material. Public page title: “Geneva Marriott Hotel, Official Hotel of CHI Geneva”; accommodation enquiries: accommodation@chi-geneve.ch. Stronger commitment evidence: the 2026 FEI jumping schedule names “Hotel name: Geneva Marriott Hotel”, says “Accommodated (bed and breakfast) from 08/12/2026 to 13/12/2026” and “At the expense of the Organiser” for CSI5* athletes. It also states “Please note that hotel rooms will not be booked automatically” and requires written NF/athlete requests to Mrs Nadja Burkhardt by 20 November 2026. Grooms and U25 accommodation are athlete-funded; accompanying parties use the same accommodation contact. This is organiser-administered participant accommodation, not evidence of an open hotel RFP. No separate external housing bureau, total block allocation or room-night commitment was identified. Marriott’s advertised 263 rooms and suites are property capacity, not the event’s contracted block.
findings.organizationStructure: Correct the supplied government/public-sector segment: the official structure identifies Association du CHI de Genève (ACHIG), with Thierry Naz as President and Guillaume Mottu as Vice-president, separately from the CHI Geneva organising committee led by General Director Sophie Mottu Morel and Sports Director Alban Poudret. Palexpo is the announced host venue; the venue listing identifies Concours Hippique International de Genève as organiser. No evidence reviewed establishes Palexpo as event owner or an external PCO/DMC as accommodation purchaser.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Core athlete lodging already has a named incumbent, Geneva Marriott Hotel, and organiser-paid terms; do not describe the entire accommodation opportunity as open. The 2024 report of sold-out sessions refers to admission, not hotels. No sourced hotel sell-out, displaced guest demand, overflow allocation or released room block was found. The organiser states most spectators, volunteers and service providers come from the surrounding region; therefore historical attendance cannot be converted into overnight demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Before 20 November 2026, contact Nadja Burkhardt with a short satellite-lodging enquiry: establish whether any unfunded/accompanying-party, exhibitor, sponsor or operational requirement is still unallocated; request actual arrival/departure dates, peak rooms, budget and transfer timetable. Explicitly acknowledge the Marriott incumbent rather than trying to displace confirmed athlete arrangements. In parallel approach Hortense Fabre about a non-exclusive secondary-hotel/partner proposition and the next sourcing-review date. Offer a small, conditional block within YOTEL’s supplied 20–120-room band only after a real brief and transfer feasibility are established; do not buy sponsorship on an assumption of room allocation. If no residual need exists, move the account to future-cycle relationship development and request a post-event review.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of 16 November 2026, public 9–13 December activity remains upcoming and participant accommodation requests are due 20 November. That is a participant booking deadline, not a supplier-selection deadline. Core organiser-funded accommodation is assigned to Marriott; accessibility for a new hotel is unconfirmed and conditional on a specific residual requirement. No open RFP or evidenced overflow permits a sales-qualified room allocation today.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: verified repeat Palexpo editions support relationship development for a future secondary-hotel or subgroup role, not presumed future vacancy or a venue-rotation bid. Ask for the next hotel sourcing review, existing partnership duration/exclusivity, and whether any sponsor/exhibitor or operational cohorts sit outside Marriott arrangements. FER lists 8–12 December 2027 at Palexpo; an organiser-issued 2027 programme and any hotel procurement cycle remain unverified. No 2028 dates were verified. Calendar publication is not hotel-sourcing accessibility.
